mentions.name: Game Boy speaker
mentions.description: A DIY speaker built from scratch that plays music from Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges, working like a record player or mini disc player for game carts. The build spans hardware, software, firmware, and enclosure design, along with considerations of legality and manufacturability, and the process is documented on video.
mentions.problem: The music on Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges is locked away inside the games, with no dedicated way to listen to it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a gameboy speaker from scratch. Kind of like a record player or mini disc player, but using gameboy and gameboy color games. Trying my best to document the process https://www.youtube.com/shorts/MQ16pvz3xeQ
